entities.name: RlmN
observations: 386-aa protein sequence is an exact full-length match to reviewed Bifidobacterium adolescentis RlmN (UniProt A1A1I4; 100% identity and coverage; E-value 2.55e-286).
RlmN is a dual-specificity radical-SAM RNA methyltransferase that methylates adenine C2 of 23S rRNA A2503 and tRNA A37.
The sequence contains a Radical_SAM domain spanning residues 138–311 and a cysteine motif consistent with binding a [4Fe–4S] cluster.
Curated annotation assigns EC 2.1.1.192 and cytoplasmic localization.

entities.name: RlmN rRNA A2503 methylation
observations: Adenosine 2503 in 23S rRNA is converted to 2-methyladenosine 2503 using S-adenosyl-L-methionine and reducing equivalents; 5'-deoxyadenosine, L-methionine, and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine are produced in the mapped radical-SAM reaction.

entities.name: RlmN tRNA A37 methylation
observations: Adenosine 37 in tRNA is converted to 2-methyladenosine 37 using S-adenosyl-L-methionine and reducing equivalents; 5'-deoxyadenosine, L-methionine, and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine are produced in the mapped radical-SAM reaction.
